result.patch_P1_likelihood_skip: CORRECT. The package loop i in (10*ns+1):(nt*ns) runs over a column-major vector of an [nt,ns] matrix, so it drops the first floor(10*ns/nt) channels entirely, not 10 time points. Patched model drops rows 1..10 for every channel and pairs data and prediction over the same sub-matrix. Own numpy model vs Stan log_prob (jacobian=False): patched exe = numpy time-mask lp + 0.5*log(2*pi)*26740 (diff 0.000 at truth and at a posterior draw, both arms); package exe (model block identical to installed vep_mcmc.stan, sha 5368394c) = numpy column-major-mask lp (diff 0.000). Vectorised Euler step (gx = SC*x - rowsum(SC).*x, synchronous update, z uses old x) is algebraically identical to the package loop. Dropped by the package: T0029 channels 0-11 plus 110 steps of channel 12 (A5-6, the strongest EZ contact, gain 8.1); T0026 channels TB'1-2..TB'10-11 plus 60 steps of B'1-2.
result.log_density_at_truth_vs_posterior: lp (patched model, jacobian=False) at planted truth 35496.0 (arm A) / 35494.1 (arm B), reproducing R3's lp_truth.json exactly; at the last draw of every chain 37958-38230. Own decomposition (arm A): truth prior kernel -2516 vs -1270..-1430 at draws; truth log-likelihood 13439 vs 14815-14926 at draws. The posterior therefore prefers the over-extended, low-amplitude configurations to the truth by ~2700 log units (prior on u/amp ~1200, over-fitting AR(1) noise with the iid likelihood ~1470).

result.failure_attribution: Predominantly PIPELINE-LEVEL (identifiability, priors, observation model), with additional run-level deficits. Pipeline-level evidence: (1) the posterior itself places the planted truth ~2700 log units below the sampled modes, so longer chains would converge to the wrong extent (PZ and insula EZ-like, amp halved); (2) the over-extension appears in every chain of both arms and in every converged L-BFGS optimum R3 reported; (3) modes separated by 250-500 lp units with near-equal fit, and in P1 a 17-region seizing mode and a no-seizure mode within 15 lp units after correcting sampling rate and likelihood; (4) the best known P1 mode never ranks Left-O2 first. Run-level evidence: treedepth saturated on 100% of draws, short runs (75/75 in T0026, 300/300 in T0029), within-mode R-hat up to 1.8-3.0, one crashed chain. Fixing the run-level issues alone would not make either benchmark pass.

uncertainty_method: Rank-normalised split R-hat and bulk/tail ESS over stored draws (own implementation, validated on simulated iid/AR(1)/shifted chains); EZ rank probability = fraction of pooled draws in which the EZ has the largest x0; false positives = P(x0 > -2.05) > 0.5 over pooled draws. Because chains do not mix, pooled probabilities are mode-count proportions, not calibrated posterior probabilities. One synthetic seed and one EZ only; no between-seed uncertainty is available.
failure_cases: VBT-P1 (A0095): documented EZ Left-O2 not recovered (pooled rank 113; best mode rank 4 with 15 FPs); unchanged after correcting sampling rate and the likelihood bug.
SYN-P2 arm A (A0097): convergence failed (x0 R-hat max 1.96, lp R-hat 2.42); EZ P(rank 1)=0.29; extent over-estimated (2 sub-threshold PZ + 3 FPs EZ-like); amp biased to half.
SYN-P2 arm B (A0097): EZ first in all chains but not converged (R-hat max 1.68) and same extent over-estimation; one seed only, so the template-SC result does not generalise.
Synthetic data were generated at the feature level, so the feature pipeline (F1-F3 fixes, sampling rate) has not been tested in any recovery benchmark.
Package defects confirmed: likelihood channel skip (P1), hard-coded sfreq=250, end zero-padding (F3, by inspection only).
verdict: NOT QUALIFIED. The vep-stim pipeline (package or T0029-patched) is not qualified for fitting HUP patients with a template connectome: neither benchmark meets the protocol v1 model_bundle criterion (convergence fails in all runs; recovery fails on P1 and on SYN-P2 arm A), and the failures are mainly pipeline-level, so more compute alone will not fix them. Gates: A0079 passed, A0095 failed, A0096 passed, A0097 failed. Before any HUP use, a revised pipeline (data-centred u/amp priors or baseline-referenced features, a noise model that accounts for autocorrelation, reparameterisation or tempering for multimodality, patched likelihood, per-file sampling rate) must pass a new synthetic recovery benchmark generated through the full feature pipeline with the template connectome, over several seeds and EZ locations, with R-hat < 1.05.
evidence_level: simulated benchmark only (virtual/synthetic patients); independent recomputation from stored draws plus cheap log-density and short L-BFGS reruns; no clinical evidence
